titulo: Gingival Fibers of the periodontal ligament
descricao_original: The gingival fibers of the periodontal ligament connect the alveolar bone and the cementum of the tooth to the gingiva and to each other at the cervix (neck) of the tooth. 100x
creditos_identificados: Image source: Image taken of a slide in the University of Michigan slide collection.

marcadores.explicacao_original: The circumferential fiber group encircles the neck of the tooth crown and thus are seen in cross section in this image. These fibers are a component of the transeptal fiber system, that extends over the alveolar bone crest and is embedded in the cementum of adjacent teeth. These fibers form an interdental ligament that maintains alignment and spacing of the teeth.
